note: Self-employed across four trades with a loyal customer base and plans to buy an aircraft next year, so 'successful' is arguable on the equivalent-to-business-owner reading, though he is a tradesman rather than the owner-or-physician profile the ICP names. He is the clearest good-to-great case in the batch — 50 years old, 167 lb at 6'1", 16.5% body fat, training six days a week and chasing 13% — and unambiguously not deconditioned. He fails on income: $375 a month against an effective $1,000, with three months of reduced earnings ahead and dependants to support. He also fails neglected_health outright — health is the part of his life that is working, which inverts the premise of the ICP entirely. This is the mirror image of the Jon Boroughs call the day before: a prospect who is exactly the physical profile the ICP describes and cannot pay, against one who can barely pay and is the physical profile it excludes.
